label: Phase 2 claim register, CSIA 2.3; written before any stock adapter. Decisions: IMPLEMENT (on a profile relation), CONTEXT (reported, read by no symptom), TRIGGER (event discovery only), NOT_IMPLEMENTED (with reason)

source_fields: control[m] (zero-order held to each ESC report)
claims.meaning: the ESC-reported rotor speed per unit of commanded thrust for motor m, relative to the other motors: q_m = (rpm_m^2 / T(c_m)) / mean_{j != m}(rpm_j^2 / T(c_j)), T = PX4's thrust model (THR_MDL_FAC). An event-relative change gives L_tel = 1 - q_after / q_before
claims.can_support: the ESC telemetry channel reports a per-motor response deficit (TELEMETRY RESPONSE)
claims.can_refute: nothing about the rotor: it is the channel whose truth is in question
cannot_establish: physical thrust
whether the rotor or the speed channel is at fault
a stall (needs ESC current)
assumptions: PX4 thrust model THR_MDL_FAC matches the propulsion
claims.content_time: esc_status timestamp of the ESC report
failure_modes: eRPM pole count wrong (scales all motors alike, cancels)
SIH: RPM is the simulated rotor state with no noise
claims.data: XSYS-001 at 10 Hz: q0 after onset equals eta (0.55 -> 0.55); nominal change <= 0.003
claims.why: finding SB-1: v2's actuation.mechanical_response is read by STALL_SIGNATURE, which takes the absence of ACT_STALLED as 'stall checked and absent'. Without ESC current a stall cannot be checked, so an RPM-only deficit on that relation would refute ACTUATION/mechanical. Emission on mechanical_response needs ESC current; no log in this repository has it, so that branch is not implemented

claims.can_support: drive stage passing (or not passing) current; the stall signature with RPM
cannot_establish: the mechanical state alone
claims.data: all zero in 66/66 flights (SIH publishes RPM only)
claims.why: no log in this repository carries ESC current; coverage reports NO_COVERAGE

claims.meaning: how much more the closed loop commands motor m than the others, after the event against before: C_m = mean_after(kappa_m) - mean_before(kappa_m), kappa_m = c_m / mean_{j != m} c_j
claims.can_support: motor m produces less physical effect per command than before: the vehicle needed it commanded harder (PHYSICAL response, closed loop)
claims.can_refute: with the power gate (a deficit of the size the telemetry reports would give C >= 2 theta): that motor m lost that much physical effect
cannot_establish: which stage of the chain failed (ESC drive, motor, propeller, command delivery)
a deficit smaller than the claim's resolution
a cause when two motors change together (centre-of-gravity or payload shift)
assumptions: controller converged (after window 10-15 s after the event)
IMU_GYRO_DNF_EN without the ESC-RPM bit (else the gyro, and so the loop, reads ESC telemetry)
failure_modes: maneuvering or wind in a window
the event window not covered by the log
claims.data: XSYS-001 at 10 Hz: kappa0 after onset equals 1/eta (1.818 at eta 0.55); nominal change <= 0.0024
claims.why: the semantics of XSYS-001's preregistered CTRL_T3 witness, which the confirmatory campaign validated as the physical discriminator in SIH; independent of the ESC telemetry channel

claims.meaning: roll and pitch rate in the first 0.2 s after the event, against before, projected on motor m's thrust-loss axis (rotor geometry from CA_ROTORn_PX/PY)
claims.can_support: a thrust loss on motor m happened at that instant (PHYSICAL VEHICLE RESPONSE)
claims.can_refute: with a gate, a thrust loss of the reported size at that instant
cannot_establish: anything when the event time is uncertain by more than the window
assumptions: event onset known to within a fraction of 0.2 s
claims.data: Phase 15 measures it at discovered onsets
claims.why: XSYS-001's W_DYN; valid only in its 0-0.2 s window, which needs the onset; reported with its validity, not fed to the profile (one physical channel per motor on the profile)

claims.meaning: PX4's control allocator could not achieve the torque or thrust demanded; which actuators are at a limit
claims.can_support: control demand not achieved; authority limit
cannot_establish: why authority was lost
claims.data: never saturated, unallocated torque 0 in 66/66 flights, including eta 0.55
claims.why: no v2 relation for allocation; used as an event trigger and as a validity input to ALLOCATOR_COMPENSATION (saturation makes compensation incomplete)

claims.can_support: a persistent torque offset is being compensated (direction gives the axis)
cannot_establish: the motor (an axis, not a motor)
claims.data: XSYS-001 A: roll and pitch integrators shift by -0.058 / +0.058 after onset; NB: 0
claims.why: redundant with ALLOCATOR_COMPENSATION and shares its lineage; a second producer would be a dependent line

claims.meaning: the battery's voltage against the declared empty voltage times cell count, and PX4's battery warning level
claims.can_support: POWER/battery out of tolerance (warning >= LOW, or voltage below empty)
claims.can_refute: POWER/path_unavailable at the battery node (voltage within band, no warning)
cannot_establish: remaining power capability
a voltage sag under load (needs measured current; current_a = -1 means not measured)
a fault between the battery and one ESC
assumptions: BAT1_N_CELLS and BAT1_V_EMPTY describe the pack
failure_modes: SIH battery is a model; current not measured
claims.data: voltage 15.3-16.2 V, warning 0, current_a = -1 in 66/66 flights

claims.meaning: PX4's own failure detector judged a failure condition
claims.can_refute: nothing (silence is NO_ANOMALY: FD_ACT_EN = 0 and no ESC current, so fd_motor cannot fire here)
cannot_establish: a cause
failure_modes: fd_motor needs ESC current and FD_ACT_EN
claims.data: every flag 0 in 66/66 flights; imbalanced_prop_metric <= 0.006 against threshold 30

claims.meaning: as the 2.2 PX4 adapter: navigation integrity, aiding, resets, source changes
claims.can_refute: nothing in the propulsion diagnosis (non-informative for the XSYS-001 fault class, pilot)
cannot_establish: a propulsion fault

claims.meaning: the value PX4's output driver computed for motor m
claims.can_support: the FMU output stage followed the allocator
claims.can_refute: nothing about delivery to the ESC (a wire or connector fault does not show here)
cannot_establish: that the ESC received the command
assumptions: the output mapping (PWM range or DShot) is known
claims.why: on actuation.command_path it would refute COMMUNICATION/command_not_delivered, which it cannot establish

claims.meaning: CPU load of the process host
claims.can_support: high load, not a performance fault
claims.can_refute: COMPUTE/resource_exhaustion only on flight hardware, with a declared headroom
cannot_establish: a missed deadline
anything about the FMU in SITL (it measures the simulation host)
claims.why: no stock producer of process deadlines exists to pair it with; high load alone is not a fault

claims.meaning: whether the log itself lost data
cannot_establish: a vehicle fault
claims.relation: producer health of every stock producer, not a vehicle claim

claims.can_support: flight segments; an event worth analysing (failsafe)
cannot_establish: a cause

claims.meaning: MAVLink link to a ground station
claims.can_refute: nothing in the vehicle's propulsion or navigation
claims.why: no symptom in scope reads it; a SITL localhost link says nothing

cannot_establish: v1.1 source health (the v1.1 trust engine is not run on PX4 logs)
claims.why: the profile's SENSOR records are the v1.1 trust engine's verdicts, which no stock topic carries; reported as topic coverage
